# Third-Party Integrations

Integrations with popular third-party libraries and formats:

- {doc}`../ibis/index` (`nominal.ibis`): an Ibis backend for querying the Nominal SQL API.
  Install with `nominal[ibis]`.
- {doc}`matlab` (`nominal.thirdparty.matlab`): export channels to MATLAB `.mat` files.
- {doc}`pandas` (`nominal.thirdparty.pandas`): upload DataFrames and export DataFrames or Series.
  Installed by default.
- {doc}`polars` (`nominal.thirdparty.polars`): export channel data in batches of DataFrames.
  Installed by default.
- {doc}`tdms` (`nominal.tdms`): upload TDMS files. Install with `nominal[tdms]`.
